== Summary ==
Prize card for the [[2022 State Championships]]. The face title reads Jedi Holocron. The lower caption reads Portable Fusion Generator (Light). The banner reads 2022 STATE CHAMPIONSHIPS. Image credit on the card: Dan Baillargeon (NickDanDesigns, Facebook). Concept line: Jonathan Wilkerson.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 State Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 17 December 2021
